key.name: core-display
key.description: How to show core CPU usage in the popup: none (hidden), per-core (individual core bars), or histogram. On systems with more than 16 cores, per-core is not available.

key.name: usage-bar-appearance
key.description: Colour of utilization bars (CPU cores, GPU, NPU): fixed uses the theme accent colour; graded interpolates green at 0%, yellow at 50%, and red at 100%.

key.name: memory-display
key.description: Memory popup detail below the Used bar: simple (available, swap) or detailed (adds free, buffers, cache, shared).

key.name: show-temperature
key.description: Show the Temperature section in the popup.

key.name: show-gpu
key.description: Show NVIDIA GPU cards in the popup when a GPU is present.

key.name: show-npu
key.description: Show Intel NPU cards in the popup when an NPU is present.

key.name: detail-view-mode
key.description: How detailed stats are shown: popup (under the panel, closes on focus loss) or dock (right-edge overlay, stays until the panel icon is toggled again). Legacy values focus-loss and toggle are treated as popup and dock.

key.name: refresh-interval-sec
key.description: Seconds between panel and popup updates.

key.name: show-disk-io
key.description: Show disk read/write rates in the popup. When off, disk stats are not read.

key.name: disk-filter-enabled
key.description: When false, disk I/O rates include all physical disks and disk-devices is only a saved selection. When true, rates include only names in disk-devices that are present; an empty list matches nothing.

key.name: disk-devices
key.description: Kernel names of physical whole disks saved for the disk filter (for example nvme0n1, sda). Used only when disk-filter-enabled is true. Partitions and virtual devices are never included.

key.name: show-network-io
key.description: Show network RX/TX rates in the popup. When off, network stats are not read.

key.name: network-filter-enabled
key.description: When false, network I/O rates include all hardware interfaces and network-interfaces is only a saved selection. When true, rates include only names in network-interfaces that are present; an empty list matches nothing.

key.name: network-interfaces
key.description: Hardware network interface names saved for the network filter (for example wlan0, enp1s0). Used only when network-filter-enabled is true. Loopback, bridges, and other virtual interfaces are never included.

key.name: temperature-fields
key.description: JSON map of temperature sensor keys to {enabled, description}. Sensors with no entry are shown with their default label.
